<module id="div_16bit">
    <description>Divides a 16-bit dividend by an 8-bit divisor using combinational logic. Compares extracted bits of the dividend with the divisor to determine the quotient and remainder.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="A" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit dividend.</input>
        <input id="B" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit divisor.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit quotient.</output>
        <output id="odd" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit remainder.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Combinational logic for division operation.</implementation>
    
    // Registers for storing inputs
    reg [15:0] a_reg;
    reg [7:0] b_reg;
    integer i;
    always @(A or B) begin
        a_reg <= A;
        b_reg <= B;
    end
    
    always @(A or B) begin
        // Initialize variables
        reg [15:0] quotient = 0;
        reg [15:0] remainder = 0;
        
        // Perform division operation
        for (i = 15; i >= 8; i = i - 1) begin
            if (remainder[i:i-7] >= b_reg) begin
                quotient[i-8] = 1;
                remainder[i:i-7] = remainder[i:i-7] - b_reg;
            end else begin
                quotient[i-8] = 0;
            end
            
            remainder[i-7:i-8] = {remainder[i-7], a_reg[i]};
        end
        
        // Assign outputs
        $display("Quotient: %d", quotient);
        $display("Remainder: %d", remainder);
    end
</module>
